caption: The drawing depicts a circular, net-like object positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The net is composed of interwoven dark lines forming a mesh pattern, with a slightly uneven, scalloped edge around the circumference. In the center of the circular net, there is a diamond-shaped design outlined with a series of small, rounded, bead-like or knot-like shapes rendered in a darker, more pronounced grayish tone. Inside the diamond shape, there are additional rounded forms, arranged in a smaller geometric configuration. The net and the internal forms are drawn with delicate, fine lines, and the entire composition is free of any color other than the variations of gray and brown present in the pencil or ink lines against the cream background. No other objects or details are present within the drawing.
title: Snood
